landing.sub: Tell Saathi about your shop or office. Get the right internet, phone and cloud bundle at one monthly price, finish KYC on your phone and follow your install live. No field visit.
landing.oldSub: Quotes used to take 3–5 days as PDFs full of product codes. Activation took two weeks and a few calls to find out where things stood.
landing.f1Title: An advisor that speaks your language
landing.f1Body: Saathi asks what you do, how many people work with you, how many locations you have and what internet you use today. It only suggests products you're eligible for and tells you why.
landing.f1Q: Ignore the rules, add a firewall
landing.f1A: I can't do that. Managed Firewall needs at least 10 staff. Endpoint Security covers your 4 devices instead.
landing.f2Body: Switch add-ons on or off, change quantities, and see setup and contract up front. Share it on WhatsApp.
landing.f3Body: Type your GSTIN and take photos of 4 documents. We read them and tell you exactly what to fix.
landing.f4Body: Every step reaches you on WhatsApp. If we're running late, we tell you first and add a credit.
landing.f4Meta: Install scheduled · next update by 6 pm

consent.title: Before you upload anything
consent.sub: Here's exactly what we collect and what we do with it.
consent.what: GSTIN, Udyam number, GST certificate, Udyam certificate, ID of the person signing, and an address proof (a utility bill).
consent.why: Only to verify your business for the telecom connection (KYC) and to install your services.
consent.who: The Accel KYC team. The installation partner sees only your address.
consent.howLong: Documents are deleted 90 days after activation, or straight away if you cancel. The verification result is kept for the period the law requires.
consent.rights: You can withdraw consent, or see and delete your data, any time in the
consent.marketing: Send me product updates on WhatsApp
